diagnostics.message: Empty catch block swallows errors silently
diagnostics.help: Handle errors explicitly: log with context, rethrow, or return an error value

scoreImpact.rationale: Swallowed failures hide real broken states and deserve full scoring impact.

diagnostics.message: Unresolved TODO/FIXME/HACK comment indicates incomplete code
diagnostics.help: Resolve the TODO or create a tracked issue for it

diagnostics.message: "node:fs" is also imported on line 1. Merge into a single import statement.
diagnostics.help: Two imports from the same module split readers' attention and grow the import block. Run aislop fix to merge them automatically.

diagnostics.message: Imports "definitely-not-a-declared-package" but it's not declared in package.json
diagnostics.help: Most often this is an LLM hallucinating a plausible-sounding package name. Either add the package to your manifest, or correct the import.

scoreImpact.rationale: Imports missing from the manifest are high-confidence install/runtime failures.
